title: The brief view (/brief, /en/brief) is the cv-ats CV on screen: same sections, the landing's dock, a still CV dialog, the blurred turning C, canonical to its landing
body:
Decided by the author 2026-10-29. The old landing lives on as the 'vista breve' / 'brief view' at /brief and /en/brief (src/pages/brief.astro, src/pages/en/brief.astro, src/components/HomeDocument.astro, src/styles/brief.css). Paths English in both locales; canonical to the locale's landing, out of the sitemap, no Open Graph, not in HREFLANG: do not change without the author.
Look, per the author: as close as possible to the cv-ats PDF (same sections and cut) plus the projects, easy to read, key data set apart (figures via splitFigures, metrics, companies, core skills). Background: the landing's C, blurred into a glow, turning slowly, with a scroll-driven parallax — pure CSS (.brief__backdrop/.brief__ring, animation-timeline: scroll()), no canvas, no WebGL (the earlier wave field was replaced). Sections are soft translucent panels with NO borders (the boxed look was 'too hard'). Reveal-on-enter fades (src/scripts/brief/boot.ts), never scroll-tied. Same dock as the landing (src/styles/chrome.css); Download CV and 'Ver el recorrido guiado' buttons at the start and the end; the CV dialog is the landing's C with ESP/EN halves, STILL, as a native popover. Under reduced motion the C must not animate at all (tokens.css would otherwise spin it at 0.01 ms).
not_derivable: The reading-first brief, the blurred C, borderless panels and the button placement were the author's instructions; the code shows the result, not which parts are requirements.
